integration_issues.issue: After clicking publish-toggle, the button text (Publier/Dépublier) does not refresh within 1.2s in some cases even though the API call succeeds and state is toggled. Not a blocker (badge PUBLIÉ/NON PUBLIÉ updates correctly and API-side state is authoritative). Suggestion: setState optimistically or await refresh before returning to idle.

critical_code_review_comments: suivi_deploy.py:982 reset_suivi: correctly resets allees/cam_allees/incidents/stock_received but does NOT touch published/published_by → publication is preserved as expected (verified). Nightly report and photos: photos are stored on doc.allees[].photos, which are also cleared via allees=[] — thus reset also removes all photos. Consider clarifying in UI copy: 'Effacer le suivi' also removes photos.

reset_suivi authorization: for non-admin non-creator, load_dataset(user_id=self) returns None → 404 (rather than 403). Behavior acceptable per spec (spec says 403 OR 404). Might expose slightly less info, which is fine.
terrain_stores: returns store_code/store_name empty in this dataset — labels rely on filename. OK for current data but consider ensuring store metadata is populated at upload.
TerrainApp/PublishCard: after publish/unpublish, no local optimistic label update (minor UX).
